purpose: Verified expansion pool discovered during targeted Training 01 research. Sources are promoted only when license and split provenance are clear.

sources.value: Real operational metro compressor data for predictive maintenance, anomaly explanation and failure prediction. Useful closed transfer set for temporal/OOD branches.
Healthy belt, faulty belt and imbalance across 17 speeds, 3 pretensions and repeated runs. Directly useful for belt/drive transfer.

sources.scale: ~2.48 GB vibration + 1.44 GB current/temperature + 45 MB acoustic
sources.value: Strong external test for multimodal electromechanical fusion and cross-sensor consistency.

sources.scale: 5.15 GB; 2,100 s runs; vibration 25.6 kHz, current 100 kHz
sources.value: Normal, inner-race, outer-race and ball faults under randomly varying 680–2460 RPM; useful for variable-speed generalization.
Recent incipient-fault dataset for early-fault sensitivity testing.
Full-scale sorting-platform conveyor with both sparse and heavily stacked material tests; useful for conveyor/material scene diversity and occlusion robustness.

sources.scale: transport subset 69 MB plus larger mining-stage subsets
sources.value: Transport subset uses a Dalsa industrial camera facing a 400 mm conveyor with manual segmentation; adds rock/material appearance and geometry diversity.
Small but permissively licensed source of visually diverse objects intended for smart-conveyor sorting; useful only as auxiliary object diversity, not conveyor context.
Conveyor-based video capture of cocoa beans; useful as additional moving-material texture/domain diversity.
Conveyor robotic-sorting environment with instance masks and orientation labels; useful for segmentation robustness, not AFR-specific semantics.

sources.scale: ~540 h normal operating sound + >12,000 anomalous samples; full corpus >440 GB, compressed ~180 GB
sources.value: One of the largest machine-sound anomaly corpora and explicitly includes a fixed toy-conveyor fault-diagnosis task. Stream only the conveyor subset after license review.
Two scaled industrial machines with source/target domains and domain shift; useful for multimodal robustness and target-domain generalization tests.
High-resolution steel/copper scrap under simulated industrial conveyor conditions; potentially excellent visual transfer set, but blocked until explicit reuse terms are confirmed.
Five material classes under real conveyor motion; relevant scene diversity if licensing is confirmed.
